item.title: Trump Cuts Gut Grant For Fair Haven “Community Schools”
item.description: The Trump administration's sudden funding cuts to groups that support school-based social services in low-income communities has imperiled after-school sports, reading help, and mental health services at two Fair Haven schools. item.title: Vigil Honors Immigrants “Kidnapped” By ICE
item.description: Standing in a circle of 100 people outside the Church Street federal courthouse, 4-year-old Joshua and 6-year-old Patricio used their red whistles to let out two sharp blasts — demonstrating a signal to let others know if immigration agents are nearby. item.title: Inspector General Clears Cops In Fatal Shoot-Out
item.description: The state's inspector general has found that a Waterbury police detective and a West Haven police sergeant were "legally justified" when they shot and killed 35-year-old Aaron Freeman during an early-morning drug raid of a Grand Avenue apartment, because Freeman fired at them first -- injuring two West Haven officers in the process. The post Inspector General Clears Cops In Fatal Shoot-Out appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Just Kidding: Schools Will Be Closed On Jan. 2, After All
item.description: The Board of Education voted Friday to close New Haven public schools on Friday, Jan. 2 -- after hearing from the state that the city was the only district in Connecticut scheduled to come back from winter recess for a one-day school week. item.title: 65-Year-Old Dies After Night On The Green
item.description: A 65-year-old homeless man died after police said he spent the night on a bench on the Green last week as temperatures dipped below freezing. On that very same night, the Elicker administration opened a third temporary warming center after New Haven'a other two reached capacity.
